ei.title: Chapter 3-08 3번: The Paradox of Innovation and Revenue
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.

questions.passage: Not all innovations that (A)[improve / worsen] human living standards show up in (B)[revenue / demand] and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of (C)[reducing / increasing] industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 인간의 생활 수준을 개선하는(improve) 혁신이 수익(revenue)과 이익에 나타나지 않으며, 기술에 의한 제품 개선은 산업 수익을 감소시키는(reducing) 역설적 효과가 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① improve — demand — reducing (B 오류: 수요가 아닌 수익)
❌ ② worsen — revenue — reducing (A 반대: 개선하다→악화시키다)
❌ ③ improve — revenue — increasing (C 반대: 감소시키는→증가시키는)
✅ ④ improve — revenue — reducing — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead (A)[accrue / diminish] directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the (B)[paradoxical / predictable] effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people (C)[purchasing / producing] the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 혁신의 혜택이 소비자에게 직접 축적되고(accrue), 기술이 역설적인(paradoxical) 효과를 가지며, 노래를 구매하는(purchasing) 사람 수에 변화가 없다면 수익이 감소한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① accrue — predictable — purchasing (B 반대: 역설적인→예측 가능한)
❌ ② diminish — paradoxical — purchasing (A 반대: 축적되다→감소하다)
❌ ③ accrue — paradoxical — producing (C 오류: 구매하는→생산하는)
✅ ④ accrue — paradoxical — purchasing — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to (A)[consumers / producers]. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song (B)[doubles / halves] with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an (C)[accompanying / unrelated] failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 혁신의 혜택이 소비자(consumers)에게 직접 축적되고, 구매 인원이 두 배가 되어도(doubles) 수익은 여전히 감소하며, 수익 감소에 수반되는(accompanying) GDP 상승 실패가 사회가 나빠졌다는 증거가 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① consumers — doubles — accompanying — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② producers — doubles — accompanying (A 반대: 소비자→생산자)
❌ ③ consumers — halves — accompanying (B 반대: 두 배→절반)
❌ ④ consumers — doubles — unrelated (C 반대: 수반되는→무관한)
det.tip: consumers(소비자) ↔ producers(생산자), doubles(두 배가 되다) ↔ halves(절반이 되다)

questions.passage: Not all innovations that ①<u>improve</u> human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead ②<u>accrue</u> directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of ③<u>expanding</u> industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people ④<u>purchasing</u> the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '확대하는(expanding)'이 아니라 '감소시키는(reducing)'이 문맥상 적절하다. 기술에 의한 제품 개선이 산업 수익을 감소시키는 역설적 효과가 있다.
det.analysis:
① improve — 개선하다, 원문 일치
② accrue — 축적되다, 원문 일치
③ expanding — 원문은 reducing(감소시키는) ←정답
④ purchasing — 구매하는, 원문 일치

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living ①<u>standards</u> show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to ②<u>investors</u>. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song ③<u>doubles</u> with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself ④<u>evidence</u> that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '투자자(investors)'가 아니라 '소비자(consumers)'가 문맥상 적절하다. 혁신의 혜택이 소비자에게 직접 축적된다.
det.analysis:
① standards — 기준, 원문 일치
② investors — 원문은 consumers(소비자) ←정답
③ doubles — 두 배가 되다, 원문 일치
④ evidence — 증거, 원문 일치

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the ①<u>paradoxical</u> effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a ②<u>quarter</u> of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much ③<u>better off</u>. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is ④<u>better off</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 마지막 문장에서 수익 감소가 사회가 '형편이 더 나빠졌다(worse off)'는 증거가 아니라고 했으므로, '형편이 더 나은(better off)'은 문맥상 부적절하다.
det.analysis:
① paradoxical — 역설적인, 원문 일치
② quarter — 4분의 1, 원문 일치
③ better off — 형편이 더 나은, 원문 일치
④ better off — 원문은 worse off(형편이 더 나쁜) ←정답
det.tip: worse off(형편이 더 나빠) ↔ better off(형편이 더 나아)

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to __________. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 혁신이 수익과 이익에 나타나지 않고, 대신 소비자(consumers)에게 직접 축적된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① innovations — 혁신 (축적 대상이 아닌 원인)
❌ ② improvements — 개선 (세 번째 문장 단어, 축적 수령자가 아님)
✅ ③ consumers — 소비자 ←정답
❌ ④ people — 사람들 (중간 이후 등장, 일반적 표현이라 '직접 축적'과 부적합)

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the __________ effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기술에 의한 제품 개선이 산업 수익을 감소시키는 역설적인(paradoxical) 효과를 가진다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① accompanying — 수반하는 (뒤에 나오는 단어, 여기선 효과의 성격을 나타내야 함)
✅ ② paradoxical — 역설적인 ←정답
❌ ③ lower — 더 낮은 (가격 문맥이지 효과의 성격이 아님)
❌ ④ reducing — 감소시키는 (뒤에 이미 reducing이 나와 중복)

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수익 감소와 GDP 상승 실패가 그 자체로 사회가 더 나빠졌다는 증거(evidence)가 아니다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① reduction — 감소 (이미 앞에서 revenue reduction으로 사용됨)
❌ ② effect — 효과 (앞에서 paradoxical effect로 쓰였으며, 증거의 자리가 아님)
❌ ③ improvement — 개선 (앞에서 product improvements로 쓰임, 증거 자리 부적절)
✅ ④ evidence — 증거 ←정답
det.tip: is not by itself evidence that = 그 자체로 ~라는 증거가 아니다

det.analysis:
✅ ① enhance — 향상시키다 ←정답
❌ ② damage — 손상시키다 (반의어 방향)
❌ ③ measure — 측정하다 (의미축 다름)
❌ ④ display — 보여주다 (의미축 다름)

det.analysis:

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 accrue의 의미와 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: (A) 어떤 변화(change)가 나타나서 사람들이 적은 비용으로 노래를 들을 수 있게 된다 / (B) 자판기를 위해 20달러 지폐를 동전으로 교환하다(change)

❌ ③ 변화 — 변화 (B는 교환의 의미)
❌ ④ 교환하다 — 교환하다 (A는 변화의 의미)
det.tip: change: (A) 변화, 변경 vs (B) 교환하다, 환전하다

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"seeming to be opposite to what is expected or true"

det.korean: 예상되거나 사실인 것과 반대되는 것처럼 보이는 → paradoxical(역설적인)

❌ ③ profitable — 수익성 있는 (의미축 다름)
❌ ④ predictable — 예측 가능한 (의미축 다름)
det.tip: paradoxical = seeming to be opposite to what is expected

questions.passage: Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the __________ (paradox) effect of reducing industry revenue.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 역설적인(paradoxical) 효과 → paradox(명사) → paradoxical(형용사)
det.analysis: the __________ (paradox) effect → effect(명사)를 수식하는 형용사 자리 → paradoxical. paradox(역설, 명사)를 paradoxical(역설적인, 형용사)로 변환.

questions.passage: The point is that revenue reduction, and an __________ (accompany) failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 수반되는(accompanying) 실패 → accompany(동사) → accompanying(현재분사/형용사)
det.analysis: an __________ (accompany) failure → failure(명사)를 수식하는 형용사 자리 → accompanying. accompany(동반하다, 동사)를 accompanying(수반되는, 현재분사/형용사)로 변환.

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much __________. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가격이 낮아지면 사람들, 즉 사회 전체는 형편이 훨씬 더 나아진다(better off).
det.analysis:
❌ ① worse off — 형편이 더 나빠 (문맥 반대: 가격 하락은 소비자 이득)
✅ ② better off — 형편이 더 나은 ←정답
❌ ③ left out — 제외된 (의미축 다름)
❌ ④ paid back — 보답받은 (의미축 다름)
det.tip: 가격이 낮아지면 사회 전체는 much better off(훨씬 형편이 나아진다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기술에 의해 야기된(brought about by) 많은 제품 개선이 산업 수익을 감소시키는 역설적 효과를 가진다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① accrue directly to — ~에 직접 축적되다 (본문 다른 곳의 표현, 문맥 부적합)
❌ ② show up in — ~에 나타나다 (본문 첫 문장 표현, 여기서는 원인이 필요)
❌ ③ fall by — ~만큼 떨어지다 (뒤 문장의 수익 하락 표현, 여기서는 원인 구문)
✅ ④ brought about by — ~에 의해 야기된 ←정답
det.tip: brought about by technology = 기술에 의해 야기된/초래된
